name: Oshawott
description: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
